Hi Jeroen,

Jeroen Ooms wrote [2013-05-01 18:12]:
> To the global lib at /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/

I think you have to update your R environment configuration in 
preferences of StatET. In your launch it points to 
/usr/lib/R/site-library. Usually it is sufficient to press the button 
"Detect Default Properties/Settings" in the dialog.

Regards,
Stephan
